Modulo \(3\): \(a^3 \equiv a \pmod 3\), so \(a^3 \equiv 1 \pmod 3 \Rightarrow a \equiv 1 \pmod 3\).

Modulo \(8\): for odd \(a\), \(a^2 \equiv 1 \pmod 8\), so \(a^3 \equiv a \pmod 8\). Thus \(a^3 \equiv 1 \pmod 8 \Rightarrow a \equiv 1 \pmod 8\).

Therefore \(a \equiv 1 \pmod{24}\). With \(1 \le a < 100\), the values are
\[
1,25,49,73,97
\]
so there are \(5\) such values.

\[
\boxed{5}
\]
